stories.title: Define ContextSnapshot and ContextPersistence trait

stories.title: Implement SqliteStorage adapter

Prefix queries use B-tree range scan (`key >= prefix AND key < prefix_successor`), not LIKE. Behind `sqlite` feature flag. Portable: `SqliteStorage::new(dir: &Path)` creates `scp.db` inside `dir`.
